In v1.0, 12,227 contributors record their own unscripted work in 15,548 environments (each one contributor's own setting of one type, such as their kitchen or workshop) across 11 setting types, 30 work categories, 56 task types and 35 action families, with 83% of hours in workplace settings. The release comprises 72,754 episodes with machine-generated action and language annotations, in LeRobot and MCAP formats under CC BY 4.0. We measure diversity along each axis, show that inside v1.0, with episodes in random order, new contributors and words keep appearing, and relate the measurements to published evidence on six data properties tied to policy performance, including hand visibility and inertial sensing. We also document collection, curation, privacy measures and data format, and provide a datasheet. Later versions of this paper will add benchmarks and cover further releases toward 100,000 hours.
tldr: HubEgo-100K is a large-scale egocentric video dataset of skilled work in real workplaces, designed to improve the diversity of robot learning data and support imitation learning generalization.
tldr_zh: HubEgo-100K 是一个大规模的真实工作场所第一人称视频数据集，旨在提高机器人学习数据的多样性，支持模仿学习的泛化。
summary_zh: 通过模仿训练的机器人策略，在训练环境与物体之外的情境中泛化能力较差。已发表的数据扩展研究表明，泛化能力随训练环境和物体多样性的增加而提升，而非依赖于每个环境中的更多演示次数。跨多个环境收集机器人数据成本高昂，而在现实世界中大规模记录以自我为中心的人类视频则是可行的；然而，现有以自我为中心的视频大多展示日常生活中的活动，较少包含真实工作场景中的熟练操作。我们提出了HubEgo-100K，一个为多样性而构建的数据集。本版本论文涵盖首次发布v1.0：包含10,124小时的1080p自我中心视频，以及来自单台头戴式手机摄像头的同步100 Hz惯性测量单元数据。在v1.0中，12,227名贡献者记录了他们在15,548个环境中的即兴工作（每个贡献者拥有自己所属的一类环境，如厨房或车间），覆盖11种环境类型、30个工作类别、56种任务类型和35种动作族，其中83%的时长为工作场景视频。该数据集包含72,754个片段，附有机器生成的动作和语言标注，以LeRobot和MCAP格式提供，并遵循CC BY 4.0许可协议。我们沿各维度衡量了多样性，表明在v1.0中，即使片段为随机顺序，新的贡献者和词汇仍不断出现，并将这些测量结果与已发表的关于六种与策略性能相关的数据属性的证据进行了关联，包括手部可见性和惯性感知。我们还记录了数据收集、整理、隐私保护措施和数据格式，并提供了数据表。后续版本的论文将添加基准测试，并逐步扩展至100,000小时的数据发布。

title: Agile Monoped Hopping on Complex and Discrete Terrain via Kinodynamic Planning with Distilled MPPI Steering
summary: This paper presents FlowRRT, a kinodynamic planner for agile monoped hopping on discrete terrain. Steering for kinodynamic RRT on complex dynamical systems currently relies on motion primitives or closed-loop policies, limiting the diversity of motions or the planning speed. Distilling a trajectory optimizer avoids both, but existing methods regress a single solution per query, which fails on monoped hopping, where the feasible action set is narrow and disconnected. Our key insight is to treat steering as set-valued and predict the distribution of feasible actions instead. A multi-start MPPI expert collects the entire feasible set of each query offline, and conditional flow matching distills it into a generative sampler. With this sampler, FlowRRT coordinates successive jumps over long horizons and finds non-greedy maneuvers that are hard for reactive policies to discover. Benchmarks across different terrains show higher success rates and substantially shorter planning times than sampling-based baselines. On terrains with inclined platforms, FlowRRT reaches $80\%$ success within $1$~s, versus $24$~s for RL-RRT and $77$~s for SST. Sim-to-sim tracking in MuJoCo confirms accurate execution under full-order dynamics.
tldr: FlowRRT is a kinodynamic RRT planner for agile monoped hopping on discrete terrain, using conditional flow matching to distill a multi-start MPPI expert into a generative set-valued steering sampler that discovers non-greedy maneuvers and achieves high success rates with much shorter planning times than baselines.
tldr_zh: FlowRRT 是一种用于离散地形上敏捷单足跳跃的动力学规划器，利用条件流匹配将多起点 MPPI 专家蒸馏为生成式集合值转向采样器，从而发现非贪婪机动，并以远短于基线的时间实现高成功率。
summary_zh: 本文提出了FlowRRT，一种针对离散地形上敏捷单足跳跃的动力学运动规划器。在复杂动力学系统上，运动学RRT的引导目前依赖于运动基元或闭环策略，这限制了运动的多样性或规划速度。通过蒸馏轨迹优化器可以避免上述两种限制，但现有方法对每个查询只回归单一解，这在单足跳跃中难以奏效，因为其可行动作集狭窄且不连通。我们的关键洞察在于将引导视为集值问题，转而预测可行动作的分布。一种多起点MPPI专家算法离线收集每个查询的完整可行集，条件流匹配将其蒸馏为一个生成式采样器。借助该采样器，FlowRRT能够在长时域内协调连续的跳跃，并发现反应式策略难以找到的非贪心机动动作。在不同地形上的基准测试表明，与基于采样的基线方法相比，FlowRRT具有更高的成功率和显著更短的规划时间。在包含倾斜平台的地形上，FlowRRT在1秒内达到80%的成功率，而RL-RRT需要24秒，SST需要77秒。在MuJoCo中的仿真到仿真跟踪验证了在全阶动力学下的精确执行。

title: A Probabilistic Lateral Motion Prediction Model with Improved Response Fidelity for Vehicle-in-the-Loop Simulation
summary: Vehicle-in-the-loop (VIL) simulation requires a lateral dynamics model that accurately reproduces vehicle responses and reliably generates horizontal lateral-position and heading commands through recursive integration. This paper presents a probabilistic lateral motion prediction model with improved response fidelity. A two-degree-of-freedom vehicle model provides the physical prior, while a recurrent neural network learns correlated residual corrections to lateral acceleration and yaw rate. To maintain prediction fidelity during recursive motion generation, multistep rollout training feeds corrected responses into subsequent states and histories and directly penalizes accumulated lateral-velocity error. A conditional Gaussian characterizes response uncertainty, which is propagated to lateral-response, position, and heading predictions through augmented-state linearization. Evaluation results demonstrate improved lateral-response and integrated-motion prediction. Compared with the Deep Dynamics lateral adaptation, the proposed model reduces mean lateral-position root-mean-square error (RMSE) from 0.596 m to 0.483 m, an improvement of 19.0%, while reducing mean lateral-velocity RMSE from 0.0469 m/s to 0.0441 m/s. These results demonstrate the effectiveness of combining physical priors, probabilistic residual learning, and multistep rollout training for response-faithful lateral motion prediction.
tldr: This paper presents a probabilistic lateral motion prediction model for vehicle-in-the-loop simulation, combining a 2-DOF vehicle model as a physical prior with a recurrent neural network for residual corrections and multistep rollout training, improving lateral response fidelity and integrated motion prediction.
tldr_zh: 本文提出一种用于车辆在环仿真的概率侧向运动预测模型，结合二自由度车辆模型物理先验与循环神经网络残差校正及多步展开训练，提高了侧向响应保真度和集成运动预测精度。
summary_zh: 车辆在环（VIL）仿真需要一种侧向动力学模型，该模型能够准确复现车辆响应，并通过递推积分可靠地生成水平侧向位置和航向指令。本文提出了一种具有改进响应保真度的概率侧向运动预测模型。两自由度车辆模型提供物理先验，而循环神经网络则学习侧向加速度和横摆角速度的相关残差修正。为了在递推运动生成过程中保持预测保真度，多步展开训练将修正后的响应馈入后续状态和历史信息中，并直接惩罚累积的侧向速度误差。条件高斯分布刻画了响应不确定性，并通过增广状态线性化将其传播到侧向响应、位置和航向预测中。评估结果表明，该模型在侧向响应和集成运动预测方面均有改进。与深度动力学侧向自适应方法相比，所提出的模型将平均侧向位置均方根误差（RMSE）从0.596 m降至0.483 m，提升了19.0%，同时将平均侧向速度RMSE从0.0469 m/s降至0.0441 m/s。这些结果证明了将物理先验、概率残差学习与多步展开训练相结合，对于实现响应保真侧向运动预测的有效性。

title: GHySSeg: Real-Time Geometric Ground and Road Segmentation for Hybrid Solid-State LiDAR
summary: Hybrid solid-state LiDAR sensors are making their way into production vehicles, yet the data they produce differs structurally from that of the established spinning mechanical sensors behind today's autonomous-driving datasets: it is ring-free, dense, cluttered, and concentrated in a frontal field of view. The classical geometric methods that autonomous vehicles rely on for drivable space computation and navigation assume the ordered ring-and-column structure of a 360-degree spinning LiDAR and degrade or fail on this data, while learned alternatives are computationally heavy, hard to certify, and trained almost exclusively on spinning-LiDAR data. We demonstrate that the same dense, per-curve geometry is instead an opportunity to close the divide between the industry's preferred sensors and autonomous-driving research. We present GHySSeg, a purely geometric method that segments ground and drivable road from a single hybrid solid-state LiDAR frame by tracing each scan curve and reading two geometric signatures, a step in height and a fold-back in range, with no training and no graphics processing unit. To evaluate it, we release HySoLiD-Drive, the first public benchmark dedicated to ground and road segmentation on an automotive hybrid solid-state LiDAR, comprising 100 manually labeled and 7000 unlabeled frames recorded by two vehicles in real driving. On this benchmark, GHySSeg surpasses both geometric and learned state-of-the-art baselines across ground and road segmentation, reaching an intersection-over-union of 0.907 for road and 0.896 for ground at over 0.96 precision, while running in real time at about 22 milliseconds per frame on a single core.
tldr: GHySSeg is a purely geometric, real-time method for ground and road segmentation on hybrid solid-state LiDAR, requiring no training or GPU, and outperforms baselines on a new benchmark HySoLiD-Drive.
tldr_zh: GHySSeg 是一种纯几何、实时的混合固态 LiDAR 地面和道路分割方法，无需训练或 GPU，并在新基准 HySoLiD-Drive 上优于基线。
summary_zh: 混合固态激光雷达传感器正逐步应用于量产车辆，然而其生成的数据在结构上与当前自动驾驶数据集背后成熟旋转机械传感器所生成的数据存在差异：混合固态数据无环状结构、密度高、杂乱，且集中于前向视场。自动驾驶车辆在可行驶空间计算与导航中所依赖的经典几何方法，均假设数据具有360度旋转激光雷达的有序环列结构，因此在此类数据上性能下降甚至失效；而基于学习的方法则计算负担重、难以认证，且几乎仅在旋转激光雷达数据上训练。我们证明，这种密集的逐曲线几何结构恰恰是弥合业界偏好传感器与自动驾驶研究之间鸿沟的契机。我们提出GHySSeg，一种纯几何方法，通过追踪每条扫描曲线并读取两种几何特征——高度阶跃与距离回折——对单帧混合固态激光雷达数据进行地面与可行驶道路分割，无需训练，亦无需图形处理器。为进行评估，我们发布了HySoLiD-Drive，首个专用于车载混合固态激光雷达的地面与道路分割公开基准，包含两辆真实行驶车辆记录的100帧人工标注数据及7000帧未标注数据。在该基准上，GHySSeg在地面与道路分割任务中均超越了几何方法与基于学习的最先进基线，道路分割交并比达到0.907，地面分割交并比达到0.896，精确率超过0.96，同时在单核上以约每帧22毫秒的速度实时运行。

title: Evolve in Panorama, Render in View: Panoramic World State Evolution for Video World Models
summary: Video world models should maintain a world that keeps evolving as the viewpoint changes. Yet when the camera turns away and returns, current models often freeze the unobserved scene, lose objects, or change their appearance, because content outside the view has no representation that keeps changing. We present PanoEvo, which uses a Panoramic Evolver to evolve the world state in the latent space of a panoramic video diffusion model, where every viewing direction is present at every time step, so the scene evolves whether or not it is observed. Existing panoramic video models are not trained to evolve a scene from a single image or the objects within it, so we build PanoEvo-Data, an event-centric dataset from real 360° videos, and train the Panoramic Evolver coarse-to-fine as an image-to-panoramic-video model. Since each view covers only a small part of the low-resolution panorama, directly projected views are blurry and often show low-quality details or structural errors. A Perspective Renderer, built on a perspective video diffusion model, reads this state via latent-space projection and direction-restricted cross-attention to render sharp, high-quality views. PanoEvo achieves the best overall score among 23 publicly evaluated models on WRBench and the highest total score on STEVO-Bench. Code, models, and data will be released.
tldr: PanoEvo introduces a panoramic world state evolution mechanism for video world models, enabling consistent scene evolution across viewpoint changes and rendering sharp views via a perspective renderer, achieving state-of-the-art results on world model benchmarks.
tldr_zh: PanoEvo 提出了一种全景世界状态演化机制，用于视频世界模型，使场景在视角变化时保持一致演化，并通过透视渲染器生成清晰视图，在多个世界模型基准上取得了最优结果。
summary_zh: 视频世界模型应维持一个随视角变化而持续演进的世界。然而，当摄像头移开再返回时，现有模型常常冻结未观测场景、丢失物体或改变其外观，原因在于视野外的内容缺乏持续变化的表征。我们提出PanoEvo，利用全景演化器在全景视频扩散模型的潜空间中演化世界状态，在该空间中每个时刻所有视角方向均存在，因此无论场景是否被观测，它都能持续演化。现有的全景视频模型并未被训练为从单张图像或其内部物体演化场景，因此我们构建了PanoEvo-Data，一个基于真实360°视频的事件中心数据集，并将全景演化器由粗到细地训练为图像到全景视频的模型。由于每个视图仅覆盖低分辨率全景的一小部分，直接投影的视图往往模糊不清，且常呈现低质量细节或结构错误。基于透视视频扩散模型构建的透视渲染器通过潜空间投影和方向受限的交叉注意力读取该状态，以渲染清晰、高质量的视图。PanoEvo在WRBench的23个公开评测模型中取得最佳综合得分，并在STEVO-Bench上获得最高总分。代码、模型和数据将予以公开。

title: CascadeJEPA: Enhancing 3D Geometric Representations via Spatially Coupled Cascaded Prediction
summary: Joint-Embedding Predictive Architectures (JEPAs) have emerged as a promising paradigm for predictive visual representation learning. However, our analysis of I-JEPA reveals a growing discrepancy between semantic and geometric learning: improved semantic recognition during pretraining is accompanied by degraded 3D geometric representations. We hypothesize that this partly stems from predicting highly abstract latent representations with incomplete spatial context, favoring semantic regularities over fine-grained geometric information. To address this issue, we introduce CascadeJEPA, a spatially coupled cascaded prediction framework that promotes richer patch-level interactions through full-grid context encoding and cross-attention between prediction stages, while largely preserving the original I-JEPA architecture. Extensive experiments demonstrate substantial improvements over I-JEPA across multiple 3D geometric tasks while maintaining strong semantic recognition performance. Furthermore, its advantages extend to future feature forecasting and world model planning, highlighting the potential of enhanced geometric representations to support predictive world modeling.
tldr: CascadeJEPA enhances 3D geometric representations in JEPA-based models by cascading predictions across full-grid contexts, improving geometric tasks and world model planning while preserving semantic performance.
tldr_zh: CascadeJEPA通过全网格上下文和级联预测增强JEPA模型的3D几何表示，改善几何任务和世界模型规划，同时保持语义性能。
summary_zh: 联合嵌入预测架构（JEPAs）已成为预测式视觉表示学习的一种重要范式。然而，我们对I-JEPA的分析揭示了语义学习与几何学习之间日益增长的差异：预训练过程中语义识别能力的提升伴随着三维几何表示能力的退化。我们推测，这一现象部分源于在不完整的空间上下文条件下预测高度抽象的潜在表示，从而偏向于语义规律而非细粒度的几何信息。为解决这一问题，我们提出了CascadeJEPA，一种空间耦合的级联预测框架，通过全网格上下文编码和预测阶段间的交叉注意力促进更丰富的补丁级交互，同时基本保留原有I-JEPA架构。大量实验表明，该方法在多项三维几何任务上相较于I-JEPA取得了显著提升，同时保持了较强的语义识别性能。此外，其优势还扩展至未来特征预测和世界模型规划，凸显了增强的几何表示在支持预测式世界建模方面的潜力。

title: Pressure Drop: Gravity Vector Estimation from a Distributed Barometric Pressure Sensor Array
summary: While gravity is often used in mobile robotics as a global constraint for Simultaneous Localization and Mapping (SLAM) algorithms, most estimation methods rely on indirect observation of the gravity vector. In this paper, we propose the use of altimeter measurements to directly observe the direction of the gravity vector. We provide a theoretical evaluation of the estimation noise and validate it through extensive experimental data, along with an evaluation of the impact of intersensor distance on our gravity vector estimates. Experimental results demonstrate that a median error of $0.87^\circ$ on the tilt estimation can be achieved with our system in semi-static scenarios. Furthermore, we demonstrate the potential of this approach by comparing it with state-of-the-art methods based on Inertial Measurement Units (IMUs). We highlight that we achieve similar performance to that of IMU-based systems in highly dynamic scenarios and even outperform in specific cases of accelerometer measurement saturation. Finally, an additional experiment shows the potential use within a robotic system through the integration into an Iterative Closest Point (ICP) algorithm.
tldr: The paper introduces a novel method for estimating the gravity vector using a distributed array of barometric pressure sensors, achieving tilt estimation accuracy comparable to IMU-based methods, with potential applications in robotic SLAM and ICP algorithms.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种利用分布式气压传感器阵列估计重力向量的新方法，在静态场景下倾斜估计的中位误差为0.87°，其性能与基于IMU的方法相当，并展示了在机器人SLAM和ICP算法中的应用潜力。
summary_zh: 虽然重力常被用作移动机器人同步定位与地图构建（SLAM）算法中的全局约束，但大多数估计方法依赖于对重力矢量的间接观测。本文提出利用高度计测量值来直接观测重力矢量的方向。我们给出了估计噪声的理论评估，并通过大量实验数据对其进行了验证，同时评估了传感器间距对我们重力矢量估计的影响。实验结果表明，在半静态场景下，我们的系统在倾斜估计上可实现中位误差为$0.87^\circ$的精度。此外，我们通过与基于惯性测量单元（IMU）的最先进方法进行比较，展示了该方法的潜力。我们强调，在高度动态场景中，我们的系统能达到与基于IMU的系统相当的性能，甚至在加速度计测量饱和的特定情况下表现更优。最后，一项附加实验展示了该方法在机器人系统中的潜在应用，即通过集成到迭代最近点（ICP）算法中实现。

title: Satisfiability Modulo Theories for Robust Synthesis of Signal Temporal Logic Specifications
summary: Signal Temporal Logic is a popular framework for describing a robotic system's goals. Once described using a temporal logic framework, synthesis turns the goals into actual steps for the robots to follow. Currently, the state of the art for sound and complete synthesis is using Mixed-Integer Linear Programming (MILP), which struggles on long time horizons and large environments, preventing the construction of guaranteed safe plans for long deployments. This paper introduces a new synthesis method using Satisfiability Modulo Theories (SMT) which scales better for long deployments and adapts to environmental changes more quickly. We do this by introducing an encoding method for STL into SMT constraints, and an encoding method for discrete-time dynamical systems modeled as a transition system. We then conduct an empirical comparison of our SMT based methods against the state of the art MILP based methods. Results show that for this class of problems, SMT is an effective encoding strategy that performs the best on long time horizon tasks.
tldr: This paper introduces an SMT-based synthesis method for Signal Temporal Logic specifications, which scales better for long time horizons and adapts more quickly to environmental changes compared to the state-of-the-art MILP-based approach. The method encodes STL and transition systems into SMT constraints and empirically demonstrates improved performance on long-horizon tasks.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种基于SMT的STL规格合成方法，相比最先进的MILP方法，在长时间范围任务上扩展性更好且能更快适应环境变化。该方法将STL和转换系统编码为SMT约束，并通过实验证明了其在长时域任务上的优势。
summary_zh: 信号时序逻辑是一种用于描述机器人系统目标的常用框架。一旦使用时序逻辑框架进行描述，综合过程便会将这些目标转化为机器人实际执行的步骤。目前，实现完备且可靠综合的最先进方法是使用混合整数线性规划（MILP），但该方法在长时间跨度和大规模环境中表现不佳，从而阻碍了为长期部署构建有安全保障计划的能力。本文提出了一种基于可满足性模理论（SMT）的新型综合方法，该方法在长期部署中具有更好的可扩展性，并能更快地适应环境变化。为此，我们引入了一种将STL编码为SMT约束的方法，以及一种针对建模为转移系统的离散时间动力学系统的编码方法。随后，我们将基于SMT的方法与基于MILP的最先进方法进行了实证比较。结果表明，对于此类问题，SMT是一种有效的编码策略，在长时间跨度任务中表现最佳。

title: Arboreus: A Realistic Boreal Forest Simulator with Topographic Terrain and Satellite-Informed Parametric Tree Distributions
summary: This work presents Arboreus, a realistic Boreal forest simulator, developed to support statistical validation of robotic autonomy algorithms in Boreal forest environments. Arboreus presents an automated methodology for synthesizing large-scale, data-informed, plausible forest worlds from parametric trees, height-variant terrain, and satellite-informed tree density distributions. The parametric generation of dominant Boreal tree species such as Birch, Spruce, and Pine is guided by trunk, canopy, and foliage parameters, extracted from growth studies in the Nordic areas. Tree distribution in an area of interest is guided by the Copernicus satellite dataset, which provides tree cover density and dominant species type at up to 10m raster resolution. The forest floor generation is guided by topographic data from the Swedish cadastral agency to produce realistic data-informed terrains. Given coordinates and extents of forested areas of interest, Arboreus synthesizes data-informed plausible forests, while offering flexibility to inject user observations of real forests (detail, age, dimensionality and tree count), which is critical for realistic synthetic data generation and for the testing of feature-sensitive autonomy algorithms. The applicability of Arboreus for benchmarking and validation of robot autonomy for different robot mobilities is demonstrated in Gazebosim, Unreal Engine, and Isaac Sim physics engines. The applicability of Arboreus as a source of synthetic forest data and its potential to support downstream forest resource mapping research (volume estimation, tree instance segmentation and stem attribute estimation) is also demonstrated. Arboreus has been open-sourced along with a dataset comprising 25 Boreal forest worlds of size 1000m2 corresponding to three real forest sites.
tldr: Arboreus is a data-informed Boreal forest simulator for generating realistic synthetic forest environments, aimed at benchmarking and validating robotic autonomy algorithms. It uses satellite data for tree distribution, topographic data for terrain, and supports multiple physics engines for robot testing.
tldr_zh: Arboreus 是一个数据驱动的北方森林仿真器，用于生成逼真的合成森林环境，以测试和验证机器人自主算法。它利用卫星数据生成树木分布、地形数据生成地形，并支持多种物理引擎进行机器人测试。
summary_zh: 本工作介绍了Arboreus，一种逼真的北方森林模拟器，旨在支持北方森林环境中机器人自主算法的统计验证。Arboreus提出了一种自动化方法，可从参数化树木、高度变化地形及卫星信息驱动的树木密度分布中，合成大规模、数据支撑且形态合理的森林世界。主要北方树种（如桦树、云杉和松树）的参数化生成，依据北欧地区生长研究中提取的树干、树冠及枝叶参数进行指导。感兴趣区域内的树木分布由Copernicus卫星数据集引导，该数据集提供高达10米栅格分辨率的树冠覆盖密度及优势树种类型。森林地表生成受瑞典地籍局的地形数据引导，以产生具有数据支撑的真实地形。给定感兴趣森林区域的坐标与范围，Arboreus可合成数据支撑且形态合理的森林，同时提供灵活性以注入用户对真实森林的观测数据（细节、林龄、尺寸维度和树木数量），这对于生成真实的合成数据以及测试对特征敏感的自主算法至关重要。Arboreus在Gazebosim、Unreal Engine和Isaac Sim物理引擎中展示了其在不同机器人移动平台自主性基准测试与验证中的适用性。同时，也展示了Arboreus作为合成森林数据源的潜力，以及其对下游森林资源测绘研究（如材积估算、单木实例分割和树干属性估计）的支持能力。Arboreus已开源，并附带一个包含25个面积为1000平方米、对应三个真实林区的北方森林世界的数据集。

title: Technical Report of Mobile Manipulator Robot for Industrial Environments
summary: This paper presents the design and implementation of Auriga Robotics' mobile manipulator robot, developed at the Robotics and Intelligent Automation Laboratory, Department of Electrical Engineering, Shahid Beheshti University. Hereafter, this platform is referred to as the @Work Robot. The robot targets industrial tasks, with an emphasis on improving efficiency in repetitive or hazardous work environments. It uses a 4-wheel Mecanum drive for omnidirectional movement and a 5-degree-of-freedom manipulator arm with a 3D-printed gripper for object handling and navigation. The electronics consist of custom PCB boards built around ESP32 microcontrollers, together with an NVIDIA Jetson Orin NX that handles high-level processing and real-time system control. On the software side, Hector SLAM provides mapping and localization, A* handles path planning, and YOLO performs real-time object detection. These modules draw on fused sensor data to deliver robust navigation and reliable collision avoidance. Overall, the system shows effective hardware-software integration, with consistent performance in autonomous navigation, object handling, and task execution in industrial-like settings.
tldr: This technical report describes the design and implementation of Auriga Robotics' mobile manipulator robot for industrial environments, integrating a Mecanum-drive base, a 5-DOF arm, and perception/navigation modules (Hector SLAM, A*, YOLO) on an NVIDIA Jetson Orin NX.
tldr_zh: 本技术报告介绍了Auriga Robotics为工业环境设计的移动机械臂机器人的设计与实现，集成了麦克纳姆轮底盘、五自由度机械臂以及基于NVIDIA Jetson Orin NX的感知与导航模块（Hector SLAM、A*、YOLO）。
summary_zh: 本文介绍了Auriga Robotics公司移动机械臂机器人的设计与实现，该机器人由沙希德·贝赫什提大学电气工程系机器人及智能自动化实验室开发，以下将该平台简称为@Work机器人。该机器人面向工业任务，重点在于提升重复性或危险工作环境中的作业效率。其采用四轮麦克纳姆轮驱动实现全向移动，并配备具有五个自由度的机械臂及3D打印夹爪，用于物体抓取与导航操作。电子系统由基于ESP32微控制器的定制PCB板构成，并搭载英伟达Jetson Orin NX模块负责高层处理与实时系统控制。软件方面，Hector SLAM用于建图与定位，A*算法用于路径规划，YOLO用于实时目标检测。各模块基于融合传感器数据，实现稳健的导航与可靠的碰撞规避。总体而言，该系统展现了良好的软硬件集成能力，在面向工业化场景的自主导航、物体抓取及任务执行中均表现出稳定一致的性能。

title: Pelorus: Resource-Aware Lidar-Inertial Odometry
summary: Lidar-inertial odometry (LIO) has an efficiency problem. High-resolution lidars produce millions of points per second that must be processed online on the resource-constrained hardware of robots, cars, or drones, yet most LIO methods neither bound their memory nor report their compute footprint. We introduce Pelorus, a resource-aware LIO with a fixed-capacity multiresolution map of voxelized normal distributions and an iterated equivariant state estimator. A relevance-based eviction keeps the map memory bounded, and a maturity-weighted map update suppresses inconsistent observations. The pipeline runs in parallel on CPUs and GPUs. On five sequences from three public datasets, Pelorus achieves the lowest relative pose error in seven of ten metrics with a small, bounded memory footprint and, with GPU offloading, the lowest CPU load of all compared methods. On an NVIDIA Jetson Orin NX, it processes a 128-beam lidar at 10 Hz. Pelorus is open source with CUDA, Vulkan, and Metal backends.
tldr: Pelorus is a resource-aware lidar-inertial odometry system that bounds memory usage with a fixed-capacity multiresolution map and parallel CPU/GPU processing, achieving low pose error and real-time performance on embedded hardware.
tldr_zh: Pelorus 是一种资源感知的激光雷达-惯性里程计系统，通过固定容量的多分辨率地图和 CPU/GPU 并行处理来限制内存使用，在嵌入式硬件上实现低位姿误差和实时性能。
summary_zh: 激光雷达惯性里程计（LIO）存在效率问题。高分辨率激光雷达每秒产生数百万个点，必须在机器人、汽车或无人机等资源受限的硬件上在线处理，然而大多数LIO方法既未限制其内存使用，也未报告其计算开销。我们提出了Pelorus，一种资源感知型LIO，采用固定容量的多分辨率体素化正态分布地图，并配备迭代等变状态估计器。基于相关性的逐出机制保持地图内存有界，而基于成熟度的加权地图更新则抑制不一致的观测。该流程在CPU和GPU上并行运行。在来自三个公开数据集的五组序列上，Pelorus在十项指标中的七项上取得了最低的相对位姿误差，且内存占用小而受限；在GPU卸载的情况下，其CPU负载在所有对比方法中最低。在NVIDIA Jetson Orin NX上，它能够以10 Hz处理128线激光雷达数据。Pelorus是开源的，支持CUDA、Vulkan和Metal后端。

title: Stochastic Diversity Windows: Diagnosing Noise Influence in Robotic Diffusion Sampling
summary: Diffusion models are increasingly adopted in robotics and control due to their capability to express multiple feasible solutions to a given task. However, the role of stochasticity in the diffusion model-sampler across denoising remains poorly understood. We introduce a per-timestep counterfactual diagnostic that tests how changing the sampled noise affects the final output. Across five model-sampler configurations spanning three robotics benchmarks, diverse architectures, domains, and conditioning mechanisms, we reveal highly varied temporal sensitivity profiles, where noise-induced deviations can amplify, partially contract, or undergo near-total attenuation downstream. From these profiles, we define stochastic diversity windows (SDWs): compact intervals that identify where sampler stochasticity has the strongest measured influence on the final output. Guided by these windows, we apply two heuristic interventions: targeted stochastic amplification, which increases sample diversity exploration of the solution space, and an SDW-hybrid sampler, which replaces DDPM steps with DDIM skips in low-impact regions, resulting in network evaluation reductions of up to 40-60% and wall-clock time by up to 85%, with no consistent changes detected in feasibility, cost, or diversity across held-out tasks.
tldr: This paper introduces stochastic diversity windows (SDWs), a diagnostic for identifying which denoising timesteps most influence final outputs of robotic diffusion policies, and demonstrates that targeting these windows can reduce computation by up to 85% without degrading performance.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了随机多样性窗口（SDWs），用于诊断机器人扩散策略中哪些去噪时间步对最终输出影响最大，并展示了针对这些窗口进行优化可在不牺牲性能的情况下将计算成本降低高达85%。
summary_zh: 扩散模型因其能够表达给定任务的多个可行解，近年来在机器人学和控制领域得到日益广泛的应用。然而，扩散模型采样器在去噪过程中随机性所发挥的作用仍未被充分理解。我们引入了一种逐时间步的反事实诊断方法，用于检验改变采样噪声如何影响最终输出。通过涵盖三个机器人基准测试、多种架构、领域及条件机制的五种模型-采样器配置，我们揭示了高度多变的时间敏感性特征，其中噪声引起的偏差在下游过程中可能被放大、部分收缩或近乎完全衰减。基于这些特征，我们定义了随机多样性窗口：即识别采样器随机性对最终输出影响最强的紧凑区间。在这些窗口的指导下，我们应用了两种启发式干预措施：靶向随机增强，以增加对解空间的样本多样性探索；以及一种基于随机多样性窗口的混合采样器，在低影响区域用确定性采样步骤替代扩散概率模型的随机步骤，从而将网络评估次数减少高达40–60%，实际运行时间减少最高达85%，而在保留任务中未检测到可行性、成本或多样性方面的一致变化。

title: Risk Density RRT$^*$: Planning in the Space of Probability
summary: Planning under uncertainty is a fundamental problem in robotics. While much of the literature seeks minimum-cost paths subject to probabilistic constraints, this paper instead considers collision probability, or risk classically defined as probability times severity, directly as the planning objective. We propose Risk Density RRT$^*$ (RD-RRT$^*$), an extension of RRT$^*$ for high-level planning in environments with deterministic and uncertain obstacles. RD-RRT$^*$ builds on Risk Density, a functional that evaluates a continuous path as a whole and provides a tractable approximation of its collision probability. The framework also supports severity-weighted risk and a hybrid variant that adds a path-length penalty, balancing risk and geometric efficiency while regularizing exploration in low-density regions. We validate the method across a wide range of scenarios. The results show that RD-RRT$^*$ consistently finds paths with lower estimated collision probability by optimizing a global risk-based objective. We further demonstrate the fidelity of the underlying approximation through Monte Carlo simulations. Finally, we discuss how the topological structure induced by Risk Density may provide a useful representation of the environment and offer insights into risk-aware planning.
tldr: This paper introduces Risk Density RRT*, a sampling-based planning algorithm that directly optimizes collision probability (risk) as the objective, supported by a tractable risk density functional for continuous paths in environments with uncertain obstacles.
tldr_zh: 本文提出风险密度RRT*算法，将碰撞概率（风险）直接作为规划目标，通过可计算的风险密度泛函在存在不确定障碍物的环境中进行路径规划。
summary_zh: 不确定性下的规划是机器人学中的一个基本问题。尽管大量文献关注在概率约束下寻求最小代价路径，本文则直接将碰撞概率——即经典定义中概率与严重性的乘积所构成的风险——作为规划目标。我们提出了风险密度RRT$^*$（RD-RRT$^*$），这是RRT$^*$的一种扩展，用于在包含确定性和不确定性障碍物的环境中进行高层规划。RD-RRT$^*$基于风险密度这一泛函，该泛函将连续路径作为整体进行评估，并对其碰撞概率提供可处理的近似。该框架还支持严重性加权风险，以及一种加入路径长度惩罚的混合变体，从而在风险与几何效率之间取得平衡，同时规范低密度区域中的探索行为。我们在广泛场景中验证了该方法。结果表明，RD-RRT$^*$通过优化基于全局风险的客观函数，始终能找到估计碰撞概率更低的路径。我们进一步通过蒙特卡洛模拟展示了所提近似的保真度。最后，我们讨论了风险密度所诱导的拓扑结构如何为环境提供有用的表示，并为风险感知规划提供洞见。

title: VLM-guided Grounding Expert for Generalised Referring Expression Comprehension
summary: Generalised referring expression comprehension (GREC) aims to identify and localise the zero, one or multiple objects referred to by a language expression. In robotic manipulation, grounding also needs to remain accurate when requests for the same objects are paraphrased or embedded in additional context in robotics. However, grounding expert models are sensitive to instruction variation, while generative vision--language models (VLMs) struggle with complete target recovery and rejection of absent targets. These complementary limitations motivate combining the contextual representations of VLMs with the direct spatial prediction capabilities of grounding experts. We therefore introduce VLM-guided Grounding Expert (VGE), which combines a frozen VLM with a trainable grounding expert through layerwise joint attention and text-conditioned instance scoring. These interfaces leverage multimodal understanding of the VLM to guide object-query refinement and candidate selection while retaining direct bounding-box prediction. Across three datasets, VGE achieves the highest averaged F1 score among the evaluated methods on all five test splits, with differences of at most 1.2 percentage points across instruction conditions within each split. On the dataset with robotic scenes, VGE also achieves the highest F1 across instruction variants and no-target, single-target and multiple-target cases. VGE provides a $5.3$--$13.0\times$ inference speedup over the baseline with the same VLM base model. These results support combining VLM context with specialised spatial prediction to address both grounding challenges, with particularly strong performance in robotic scenes. Code will be released upon publication.
tldr: The paper introduces VGE, a model combining a frozen VLM with a trainable grounding expert via layerwise joint attention and text-conditioned instance scoring, achieving state-of-the-art generalized referring expression comprehension with significant speedups, particularly in robotic scenes.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了VGE，通过层间联合注意力和文本条件实例评分将冻结的VLM与可训练的接地专家相结合，在广义指代表达理解任务中取得领先性能，尤其在机器人场景下，并实现显著加速。
summary_zh: 广义指代表达理解（GREC）旨在识别并定位语言表达所指代的零个、一个或多个目标物体。在机器人操作中，当针对相同物体的请求以改写形式表达或嵌入了额外的上下文时，指代定位仍需保持准确。然而，指代定位专家模型对指令变化较为敏感，而生成式视觉-语言模型（VLM）则在完整目标恢复和拒绝不存在的目标方面存在困难。这些互补的局限促使我们将VLM的上下文表征与指代定位专家的直接空间预测能力相结合。为此，我们提出了VLM引导的指代定位专家模型（VGE），该模型通过分层联合注意力和文本条件实例评分，将冻结的VLM与可训练的指代定位专家相结合。这些交互接口利用VLM的多模态理解能力来引导对象查询的细化和候选选择，同时保留直接的边界框预测。在三个数据集上，VGE在所有五个测试划分中取得了评估方法中最高的平均F1分数，且每个划分内不同指令条件之间的差异最多为1.2个百分点。在包含机器人场景的数据集上，VGE在指令变体以及无目标、单目标和多目标情形下同样取得了最高的F1分数。与使用相同VLM基础模型的基线相比，VGE实现了$5.3$--$13.0\times$的推理加速。这些结果支持将VLM上下文与专门的空间预测相结合来解决指代定位中的两类挑战，且在机器人场景中表现尤为突出。代码将在论文发表后公开。

title: Where Do Human-to-Robot Transfer Gains Come From?
summary: Human data can support robot policy pretraining, but gains attributed to a data recipe may also reflect subset size, training variability, or downstream adaptation. In an HPT implementation on a 20-task MetaWorld suite with three training blocks, a constrained random 5,000-recording subset matches most of the task-informed subset's gain over the 40,000-recording pool at 20,000 updates (3.69 of 4.29 percentage points), leaving equal-size selection differences of 0.60 points at 5,000 recordings and 0.45 points at 1,250 recordings, with wide paired intervals. Across 12 comparisons, task orderings repeat across seeds for several contrasts, but a fixed predictor built from the other two seeds trails the mean or difficulty reference in at least one held-out fold for every comparison. Neither mechanism probe shows its predicted positive interaction: task-slot mismatch yields an interaction of $-0.0347$ points after adaptation, and in a six-task observation experiment the observation-by-pretraining interaction changes sign between seeds ($-18.29$ and $+1.04$ points) while full-state pretraining gains are positive in both ($+6.37$ and $+2.31$ points). This retrospective study shows how equal-size and capacity controls, seed-level reporting, and targeted interventions change the interpretation of apparent transfer gains.
tldr: This paper investigates the sources of human-to-robot transfer gains in a human-robot transfer (HPT) setup on MetaWorld, showing that apparent gains largely stem from subset size and training variability rather than task-informed data selection or mechanistic predictions.
tldr_zh: 本文在MetaWorld上的HPT设置中研究了人-机器人迁移收益的来源，表明表面上的收益主要来自子集大小和训练变异性，而非任务知情的数据选择或机制预测。
summary_zh: 人类数据可以支持机器人策略预训练，但归因于数据配方的性能提升也可能反映子集规模、训练变异性或下游适应等因素。在一个基于20任务MetaWorld套件、包含三个训练块的HPT实现中，一个受约束的随机5，000条记录子集在20，000次更新时，其相对于40，000条记录总池的性能提升大部分与基于任务信息的子集相当（4.29个百分点中的3.69个百分点），在5，000条记录时等规模选择差异为0.60个百分点，在1，250条记录时为0.45个百分点，且成对区间较宽。在12项比较中，多种对比的任务排序在不同随机种子间重复出现，但由另外两个种子构建的固定预测器在所有比较中至少在一个留出折上落后于均值或难度参考。两种机制探测均未显示出预期的正向交互作用：任务槽错配在适应后产生$-0.0347$个百分点的交互效应，而在一个六任务观察实验中，观察与预训练之间的交互效应在不同种子间改变了符号（$-18.29$和$+1.04$个百分点），而全状态预训练增益在两种情况下均为正（$+6.37$和$+2.31$个百分点）。这项回顾性研究表明，等规模与容量控制、种子级报告以及针对性干预如何改变对表面迁移增益的解释。

title: TRIDENT: Efficient Triple-Task Learning of Dehazing, Depth, and Uncertainty Estimation for Underwater 3-D Robot Visual Perception
summary: Underwater visual systems often suffer from blurry textures and low color contrast due to the inevitable light propagation. These issues can significantly degrade the perception of stable robotic operations. In this paper, we introduce a novel learning-based sensing system that tackles the multidimensional vision tasks in underwater; concretely, we deal with image enhancement, depth estimation, and uncertainty for 3-D visual systems. Also, we propose a TRIDENT model in a fast and lightweight manner; TRIDENT consists of three parallelized decoders and one backbone structure for efficient feature sharing. In addition, it is designed to be trained to express complex parameterization. In experimental evaluation on several standard datasets, we demonstrate that TRIDENT significantly outperforms other existing methods on image enhancement and depth estimation. Despite performing three tasks, our model has better efficiency than the others for both memory size and inference time. Finally, our joint learning approach demonstrates robustness in feature matching and seamlessly extends from 2-D to 3-D vision tasks. Supplements are available at https://sites.google.com/view/underwater-trident/home
tldr: TRIDENT is a lightweight multi-task learning model that simultaneously performs underwater image dehazing, depth estimation, and uncertainty estimation, improving 3D robotic visual perception with high efficiency and robustness.
tldr_zh: TRIDENT是一个轻量级多任务学习模型，同时进行水下图像去雾、深度估计和不确定性估计，以高效且稳健的方式提升3D机器人视觉感知。
summary_zh: 水下视觉系统常因不可避免的光传播而遭受纹理模糊和色彩对比度低的问题。这些问题会显著降低稳定机器人操作的感知能力。本文提出了一种新颖的基于学习的传感系统，用于解决水下的多维视觉任务；具体而言，我们处理图像增强、深度估计以及面向三维视觉系统的不确定性。同时，我们提出了一种以快速且轻量方式实现的TRIDENT模型；TRIDENT由三个并行解码器和一个用于高效特征共享的主干结构组成。此外，该模型被设计为能够训练以表达复杂的参数化关系。在多个标准数据集的实验评估中，我们证明TRIDENT在图像增强和深度估计方面显著优于现有方法。尽管执行三项任务，我们的模型在内存大小和推理时间方面的效率均优于其他方法。最后，我们的联合学习方法在特征匹配方面展现出鲁棒性，并能无缝地从二维视觉任务扩展到三维视觉任务。补充材料可在https://sites.google.com/view/underwater-trident/home获取。

title: Haptic Probing for Subsurface-Aware Force Distribution on Layered Soft Tissue
summary: Force-regulated contact with layered soft tissue fails most often where the subsurface composition changes: controllers infer the substrate from the loading signal alone, so the estimate guiding them lags the change---more acutely, we argue, over compliant than over bone-backed tissue. We remove that lag with a separate haptic channel. Under a light preload, a brief low-amplitude excitation lets the local dynamic admittance discriminate muscle from bone-backed tissue relative to a per-subject baseline, before task force is applied---active haptic sensing used to commit a control decision rather than to characterise tissue. A force- and tactile-driven distribution law then consumes that regime throughout execution: an instantaneous allocation equalises pressure across the engaged fingertips, while the regime sets the admissible pressure and hence the area the hand must recruit to deliver the target force---making patch area a controlled variable rather than a by-product. Probing, switches and recruitment are priced in a partitioned passivity budget, so safety monitoring cannot suppress the probe and a refused recruitment forfeits force tracking rather than the pressure bound. We report force tracking and pressure uniformity over curved, migrating contact on three human subjects, with regime labels from anatomical landmarks.
tldr: This paper introduces a haptic probing method that uses a brief low-amplitude excitation under light preload to identify subsurface tissue type before force application, then uses this regime label to control force distribution across a robotic hand on layered soft tissue, improving force tracking and pressure uniformity on human subjects.
tldr_zh: 本文提出一种触觉探测方法，在轻预载下通过短暂低幅激励区分皮下组织类型，并将该信息用于控制机械手上的力分布，以改善软组织的力跟踪和压力均匀性。
summary_zh: 力控接触分层软组织时，失败最常发生在皮下组织成分发生变化的位置：控制器仅依赖加载信号推断基底特性，因此指导控制的估计值滞后于组织变化——我们认为，相较于骨支撑组织，在柔顺组织上这种滞后更为显著。我们通过独立的触觉通道消除该滞后。在轻预载条件下，短暂的低幅激励使局部动态导纳能够在施加任务力之前，相对每名受试者的基线区分肌肉与骨支撑组织——即利用主动触觉感知做出控制决策，而非表征组织特性。随后，基于力与触觉驱动的分配律在执行过程中持续应用该判别结果：瞬时分配使接触指尖间的压力均衡，而组织类型设定允许压力上限，从而决定手部为传递目标力所需征召的接触面积——使接触斑块面积成为受控变量而非副产物。探测、切换与征召过程在分区无源性预算内进行代价核算，因此安全监控不会抑制探测动作，而拒绝征召只会丧失力跟踪能力，而非突破压力边界。我们报告了三名受试者在弯曲、移动接触条件下的力跟踪与压力均匀性结果，组织类型标签以解剖标志为基准。

title: CRA: Continuous Risk Assessment for Safety-critical Visual Navigation
summary: Traditional safety-critical control methods often rely on predefined constraints that separate states into safe and unsafe regions. While recent studies have extended geometric safety toward semantic safety, real-world safety is rarely purely binary. The risk associated with an object or human can vary continuously with its physical properties, like motion, and interaction context; for example, a person carrying a heavy object or a hot object moving at high speed may require a different safety response from an ordinary static obstacle. In this paper, we propose a vision-based continuous risk assessment framework for safety-critical visual navigation. Our method uses RGB and LiDAR observations to estimate four risk factors (kinetic, potential, contact-severity, and thermal) and combines them into a continuous risk score for each assessed object or person. These estimates are integrated into a Poisson safety function with a Laplace guidance field as a safety filter, enabling online monitoring and intervention in open-world robot navigation. We demonstrate the proposed method in a simulated restaurant scene.
tldr: CRA estimates continuous risk scores from visual and LiDAR data and integrates them into a safety filter for open-world robot navigation, demonstrated in a simulated restaurant.
tldr_zh: CRA从视觉和LiDAR数据中估计连续风险分数，并将其整合到安全过滤器中，用于开放世界机器人导航，并在模拟餐厅中进行了演示。
summary_zh: 传统安全关键控制方法往往依赖于将状态划分为安全与不安全区域的预定义约束。尽管近期研究已将几何安全拓展至语义安全，但现实世界中的安全极少是纯粹二元性的。物体或人员相关的风险会随其物理属性（如运动状态）及交互情境而连续变化；例如，携带重物或高温物体高速移动的人员，可能需要与普通静态障碍物不同的安全响应。本文提出了一种基于视觉的连续风险评估框架，用于安全关键的视觉导航。该方法利用RGB和激光雷达观测数据，评估四个风险因子（动能、势能、接触严重度和热风险），并将其组合为每个被评估物体或人员的连续风险评分。这些估计被整合到带有拉普拉斯引导场的泊松安全函数中，作为安全滤波器，实现在开放世界机器人导航中的在线监测与干预。我们在模拟餐厅场景中验证了所提方法。

title: ASTRA: ASV Simulator for Transferable Realistic Autonomy
summary: Autonomy development for marine autonomous surface vehicles (ASVs) remains challenging because field testing is costly and difficult to reproduce. Existing marine simulation tools provide mature capabilities in vessel dynamics, robotics integration, and visual rendering, but these strengths are emphasized differently across platforms. This paper presents ASTRA, an ASV simulation framework built in NVIDIA Isaac Sim that combines marine vehicle dynamics, photorealistic perception, and Robot Operating System (ROS 2) autonomy interfaces within a common environment. ASTRA incorporates a Fossen-style marine dynamics model together with geometry-based buoyancy and programmable spectral wave disturbances, enabling non-planar hydrostatic and wave-induced motion. The simulator reproduces the sensor configuration of a physical BlueBoat testbed, including GPS, IMU, LiDAR, and RGB-D sensing exposed through ROS 2. This allows localization, perception, planning, and control software to be developed against interfaces consistent with the physical platform. The BlueBoat's existing ROS 2 localization and perception modules were ported directly into ASTRA, while targeted zero-propulsion experiments were used to verify the implemented wave-body coupling. The simulated roll response was consistent with the expected non-oscillatory hydrostatic behavior, and heave remained highly coherent with the generated wave field, with approximately unity gain at the dominant wave frequency in the tested sea states. ASTRA is intended as an open-source testbed for marine autonomy development, simulation-based benchmarking, and sim-to-real experimentation.
tldr: ASTRA is a marine ASV simulator built in NVIDIA Isaac Sim that combines Fossen-style dynamics, photorealistic perception, and ROS 2 interfaces, verified against a physical BlueBoat testbed for sim-to-real transfer.
tldr_zh: ASTRA 是一个基于 NVIDIA Isaac Sim 的自主水面艇模拟器，结合 Fossen 动力学、真实感感知和 ROS 2 接口，通过物理 BlueBoat 测试平台验证，支持仿真到现实的迁移。
summary_zh: 自主水面车辆（ASVs）的自主性开发仍具挑战性，因为现场测试成本高昂且难以复现。现有的海洋仿真工具在船舶动力学、机器人集成和视觉渲染方面提供了成熟的能力，但这些优势在不同平台上的侧重各有不同。本文介绍了ASTRA——一个基于NVIDIA Isaac Sim构建的ASV仿真框架，它在同一环境中整合了船舶动力学、逼真感知以及机器人操作系统（ROS 2）自主性接口。ASTRA采用Fossen式海洋动力学模型，结合基于几何的浮力计算和可编程的谱波浪扰动，能够实现非平面静水及波浪诱导运动。该仿真器复现了物理BlueBoat测试平台的传感器配置，包括通过ROS 2暴露的GPS、IMU、LiDAR和RGB-D感知功能。这使得定位、感知、规划与控制软件的开发能够基于与物理平台一致的接口进行。BlueBoat现有的ROS 2定位与感知模块被直接移植到ASTRA中，同时通过针对性的零推进实验验证了所实现的波-体耦合。仿真中的横摇响应与预期中的非振荡静水特性一致，垂荡与生成的波浪场保持高度相干，在测试海况下主波频率处的增益约等于1。ASTRA旨在成为一个开源测试平台，用于海洋自主性开发、基于仿真的基准测试以及仿真到实物的实验研究。

title: Better Calibrated, Better Planned: Uncertainty-Aware Multi-ASV Informative Path Planning for Oil Spill Monitoring
summary: Monitoring oil spills with fleets of Autonomous Surface Vehicles (ASVs) requires mapping a heterogeneous pollutant field from sparse, noisy measurements under tight time and energy budgets. Informative Path Planning (IPP) addresses this problem by coupling a reconstruction model, which infers the field and its uncertainty, with a planner that decides where to sample next. Prior work has focused on planning strategies and has largely relied on Gaussian Processes (GPs), leaving the calibration of the model's uncertainty underexplored. We study how uncertainty calibration conditions multi-vehicle IPP with a fleet of ASVs that coordinates online through a shared uncertainty map. We introduce Evidential Deep Learning (EDL) as an uncertainty-calibrated information model. We benchmark EDL, Monte Carlo Dropout and Deep Ensembles against a GP in closed loop with five planners on physics-based oil spill simulations. Across 60 maps, the choice of model dominates the outcome, explaining 80\% of the variance of the final reconstruction error, against 1\% for the planner among the deep models. EDL achieves the lowest error and the highest IoU under every planner, is the best calibrated model and runs at 3.9 ms per step. With 50 cells per vehicle it reconstructs the spill better than MC Dropout and Deep Ensembles with 150. Deep Ensembles become more confident as their error grows, whereas EDL is unaffected. Robustness of the information model to the data its own planner collects is therefore a requirement of uncertainty-aware IPP.
tldr: This paper investigates uncertainty calibration in multi-vehicle informative path planning for oil spill monitoring with Autonomous Surface Vehicles, introducing Evidential Deep Learning as a calibration-aware information model that outperforms Gaussian Processes and other deep models in closed-loop planning.
tldr_zh: 本文研究了多水面无人艇油污监测信息路径规划中的不确定性校准问题，提出使用证据深度学习作为信息模型，在闭环规划中优于高斯过程和现有深度模型。
summary_zh: 利用自主水面航行器（ASVs）编队监测海上溢油，需要在严格的时间和能量预算约束下，根据稀疏且含噪声的测量数据绘制非均质污染物场分布图。信息路径规划（IPP）通过将推断场分布及其不确定性的重建模型与决定下一步采样位置的规划器相结合来应对这一挑战。以往研究主要聚焦于规划策略，并大多依赖高斯过程（GPs），对模型不确定性校准的探讨相对不足。本文研究了不确定性校准如何影响由共享不确定度图进行在线协调的ASVs编队进行多航行器IPP的性能。我们引入证据深度学习（EDL）作为一种不确定性校准的信息模型。在基于物理的溢油模拟环境中，我们将EDL、蒙特卡洛Dropout和深度集成与GP在闭环条件下进行对比，使用五种规划器进行基准测试。在60张地图上的实验结果表明，模型的选择对结果起主导作用，解释了最终重建误差方差的80%，而规划器在深度模型之间的方差贡献仅为1%。EDL在每种规划器下均取得最低误差和最高的IoU值，是最佳校准模型，且每步运行时间仅为3.9毫秒。在每台航行器分配50个采样单元的条件下，EDL的重建效果优于使用150个采样单元的MC Dropout和深度集成。深度集成在误差增大时置信度反而提高，而EDL不受此影响。因此，信息模型对其自身规划器采集的数据的鲁棒性是实现不确定性感知IPP的必要条件。

title: An Open-Source da Vinci X/Xi Instrument Module for Laparoscopic Surgery Research
summary: Studying electrosurgical tasks on a research robot requires control of both instrument motion and energy activation, along with a record of when each action occurs. This paper presents an open-source module for da Vinci X/Xi instruments on a UR5/UR5e robotic arm. Five motors transmit torque through timing belts to spring-loaded drive discs. An electrosurgical interposer accepts software commands, gives the surgeon's foot pedals priority, and records the source of each activation request. In bench testing, the interposer recorded all 12 activation and deactivation events from six pedal presses. Ex vivo demonstrations included monopolar and bipolar coagulation of splenic tissue and monopolar cutting during gallbladder dissection. Optical tracking of the Fenestrated Bipolar Forceps showed that calibration brought pitch and yaw gains from 0.904 and 1.14 to 1.00 and 1.02, respectively. The module enables researchers to record instrument motion, video, and the timing and source of electrosurgical commands during laparoscopic tasks.
tldr: This paper presents an open-source hardware and software module for controlling da Vinci surgical instruments on a UR5 robotic arm, enabling research in laparoscopic electrosurgery with synchronized motion, video, and energy activation recording.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了一种开源硬件和软件模块，用于在UR5机械臂上控制达芬奇手术器械，实现腹腔镜电外科研究中的运动、视频和能量激活同步记录。
summary_zh: 研究机器人上开展电外科任务，需同时控制器械运动与能量激活，并记录各动作发生的时间。本文介绍一款开源模块，适用于UR5/UR5e机械臂上的达芬奇X/Xi器械。五个电机通过同步带将扭矩传递至弹簧加载的驱动盘。电外科转接器接收软件指令，优先响应外科医生脚踏板操作，并记录每次激活请求的来源。在台架测试中，该转接器准确记录了六次踏板按压产生的全部12次激活与去激活事件。体外演示包括脾脏组织的单极与双极凝血，以及胆囊 dissection 过程中的单极切割。对带窗双极抓钳的光学追踪显示，校准后俯仰与偏航增益分别由0.904和1.14提高至1.00和1.02。该模块使研究人员能够在腹腔镜任务中同步记录器械运动、视频以及电外科指令的时序与来源。

title: Towards Data-Efficient, Real-Time World Models
summary: State-of-the-art world models have been used to produce sequences of gameplay that accord with provided user-input actions. However, high quality, consistent gameplay generation often comes at the cost of inference speed, making real-time interactive play and ideation challenging. The substantial quantities of data used to train state-of-the-art models have also made custom training of these models appear impractical, limiting many of their potential uses in creative fields. In this work we demonstrate a major step towards efficient world models: achieving both fast high-quality inference, and improved data efficiency. This is done by replacing the next-token prediction paradigm with a two-stage discrete diffusion-based approach, introducing a lightweight refinement transformer which carries out iterative masked predictions. Building on an autoregressive world model capable of generating highly consistent and complex sequences over minutes (Kanervisto et al., 2025), we achieve substantial model speed-up (79x) with a modest quality trade-off. Additionally, we demonstrate that this model can be trained to reproduce high-quality, consistent gameplay using a dataset containing approximately one day (28 hours) of gameplay data. Our results demonstrate progress towards removing barriers to the use of world models in settings where real-time inference and data efficiency are essential.
tldr: This paper introduces a two-stage discrete diffusion approach with a lightweight refinement transformer to speed up autoregressive world models by 79x while improving data efficiency, enabling training on only 28 hours of gameplay data.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种两阶段离散扩散方法，并引入轻量级精炼变换器，将自回归世界模型加速79倍，同时提高数据效率，仅需28小时的游戏数据即可训练。
summary_zh: 最先进的世界模型已被用于生成与所提供的用户输入动作相符的游戏玩法序列。然而，高质量且一致的游戏生成往往以推理速度为代价，这使得实时交互式游玩和构思面临挑战。用于训练最先进模型的大量数据也使得这些模型的定制训练显得不切实际，限制了其在创意领域的许多潜在应用。在本工作中，我们展示了迈向高效世界模型的重要一步：在实现快速高质量推理的同时，提升了数据效率。这一进展通过将下一标记预测范式替换为一种两阶段离散扩散方法来实现，并引入了一个轻量级细化变换器，用于执行迭代式掩码预测。基于一个能够生成持续数分钟高度一致且复杂序列的自回归世界模型（Kanervisto等，2025），我们实现了显著的模型加速（79倍），同时仅带来适度质量权衡。此外，我们证明了该模型可以使用包含约一天（28小时）游戏数据的数据集进行训练，从而再现高质量且一致的游戏玩法。我们的结果表明，在实时推理和数据效率至关重要的场景中，这项研究在消除世界模型应用障碍方面取得了进展。

title: Algorithm Distillation for Safe In-Context Reinforcement Learning
summary: Safe in-context reinforcement learning (Safe ICRL) asks a policy with fixed parameters to improve on an unseen constrained task from its interaction history while aiming to keep its cost within a budget. Prior work studied Safe ICRL on five benchmarks in three families: a grid world with a hidden goal and obstacles (DarkRoom), continuous navigation where goals and hazards stay invisible until reached (PointGoal, CarGoal), and locomotion with a hidden velocity limit (HalfCheetah, Ant). Safe Algorithm Distillation (Safe AD), trained on the learning histories of a safe RL algorithm, has shown adaptation failures in prior evaluations. For example, in the locomotion tasks its return stays below zero, and it rarely reaches the goal in CarGoal. We revisit two parts of Safe AD. First, we distill a budget-aware teacher with two phases. It searches for the hidden task, exploring more when more budget remains. After its first reward or cost, an expert policy exploits the task within the remaining budget. We collect the teacher's histories under fixed or dynamic budgets. Dynamic budgets increase the occupancy entropy of the return and budget inputs in every environment, and at test time they improve return and lower cost in DarkRoom and HalfCheetah. Second, we propose A-Lag, a test-time adjustment that reweights the distilled policy's actions by their predicted cost, with an adaptive Lagrange multiplier that is updated from the costs observed. In our experiments, A-Lag had lower mean episode cost than Safe AD in all five environments, with lower mean final return in four.
tldr: This paper revisits Safe Algorithm Distillation for safe in-context reinforcement learning, proposing a budget-aware two-phase teacher and an adaptive Lagrange multiplier test-time adjustment (A-Lag) to improve return and reduce cost across five safe RL benchmarks.
tldr_zh: 本文重新审视了安全算法蒸馏在安全上下文强化学习中的应用，提出了预算感知的两阶段教师和自适应拉格朗日乘子测试时调整（A-Lag），在五个安全RL基准上提高了回报并降低了代价。
summary_zh: 安全上下文强化学习（Safe ICRL）要求一个参数固定的策略仅凭其交互历史在未见过的约束任务上实现改进，同时力求将代价控制在预算之内。已有研究在三个族系的五个基准上考察了Safe ICRL：一个具有隐藏目标与障碍物的网格世界（DarkRoom）、目标与危险物在到达前不可见的连续导航任务（PointGoal、CarGoal），以及带有隐藏速度限制的运动任务（HalfCheetah、Ant）。安全算法蒸馏（Safe AD）在安全强化学习算法的学习历史上训练，在以往评估中表现出适应失败的问题。例如，在运动任务中其回报始终低于零，且在CarGoal中很少到达目标。我们重新审视了Safe AD的两个组成部分。首先，我们蒸馏一个两阶段、具有预算意识的教师模型。该模型搜索隐藏任务，在预算更充裕时探索更多。在获得首次奖励或代价后，由专家策略在剩余预算内利用该任务。我们在固定预算和动态预算两种条件下收集教师的历史数据。动态预算在所有环境中增加了回报与预算输入的占用熵，并且在测试时，在DarkRoom和HalfCheetah中提升了回报、降低了代价。其次，我们提出A-Lag，一种测试时调整方法，通过预测代价对蒸馏所得策略的动作重新加权，并采用从观测到的代价中更新的自适应拉格朗日乘子。在我们的实验中，A-Lag在所有五个环境中的平均回合代价均低于Safe AD，但在四个环境中的平均最终回报更低。

title: Network-Exposed Configuration Attacks on LLM-Controlled Social Robots
summary: Large language models (LLMs) in embodied robots create security dependencies beyond inference. We investigate a network-exposed configuration attack on the Pollen Robotics Reachy Mini Lite, allowing an unauthenticated attacker to replace personality settings and the cloud LLM's system prompt through a management interface, without adversarial conversational input. Eleven prompt-injection attempts across five categories were reported as resisted, whereas both configuration-layer attack paths produced observable behavioural changes on physical hardware. We demonstrate local and network-adjacent access, mapping the weakness to CWE-306 (Missing Authentication for a Critical Function) and CWE-1327 (Binding to an Unrestricted IP Address), with a reported CVSS v3.1 score of 6.5 (Medium). A configuration endpoint also accepts cross-origin requests without a CORS preflight (CWE-352; 6.5 Medium), while the persistent-memory sink stores content without enforcing its stated restrictions. A source review of 59 public repositories identifies missing authentication in 10 of 11 source-verifiable genuine applications, or 11 of 11 including a framework-default case. These findings indicate recurrence within the sampled repositories, not prevalence in commercial products. We characterise a deployment gap between developer-oriented network assumptions and consumer-facing embodied AI security: inference-layer refusal cannot prevent unauthorised changes to model instructions. Potential consequences include surveillance through onboard cameras and microphones and social engineering of nearby users. Proof-of-concept code, evidence and the survey are available at https://bit.ly/reachypi.
tldr: This paper investigates a network-exposed configuration attack on the Pollen Robotics Reachy Mini Lite social robot, demonstrating that unauthenticated attackers can alter personality settings and the cloud LLM's system prompt through a management interface, bypassing inference-layer refusals and causing behavioral changes on physical hardware. The study maps the vulnerability to CWE-306 and CWE-1327, reports a CVSS score of 6.5, and identifies missing authentication in the majority of sampled public repositories, highlighting a security gap in consumer-facing embodied AI.
tldr_zh: 本文研究了Pollen Robotics Reachy Mini Lite社交机器人上一种网络暴露的配置攻击，证明未经认证的攻击者可通过管理界面修改人格设置和云端LLM的系统提示词，绕过推理层拒绝并导致物理硬件上的行为变化。研究将该漏洞映射至CWE-306和CWE-1327，报告CVSS评分为6.5，并发现样本公共仓库中多数存在认证缺失，突显了面向消费者的具身AI安全缺口。

title: DGF-Asym: Adaptive Peer Weighting for Collective Estimation under Noisy and Faulty Sensing
summary: Collective estimation under unreliable sensing requires robots to adaptively balance personal observations and social information from peers. We propose DGF-Asym, a decentralized collective estimation method extending the DeGroot-Friedkin model with asymmetric peer weighting based on retrospective predictive performance. The method supports consensus formation without prior sensor-noise statistics or explicit fault models while keeping inter-robot communication asynchronous. We evaluate DGF-Asym in simulated collective navigation under noisy observations and time-varying sensor faults. Compared with three baselines, it produces more stable estimates and more reliably sustains the decision criterion, at the cost of longer decision times. However, overall performance depends on fault ratio, group size, and influence-threshold selection. Our results demonstrate the potential of adaptive peer weighting for stable model-free collective estimation under unreliable sensing.
tldr: This paper proposes DGF-Asym, a decentralized collective estimation method that extends the DeGroot-Friedkin model with adaptive asymmetric peer weighting based on retrospective predictive performance, enabling consensus formation under noisy sensing and faults without prior noise statistics.
tldr_zh: 本文提出DGF-Asym，一种基于回顾性预测性能的异步自适应对等加权去中心化集体估计方法，在不需要先验噪声统计的情况下，实现对嘈杂和故障传感下的稳定共识形成。

title: COAST: Safe Flight Corridor Planner for Fast and Robust Snap Minimized Trajectories
summary: Current B-Spline trajectory planners face a critical trade-off: they either sacrifice computational speed to maintain strict Safe Flight Corridor (SFC) guarantees, or they abandon hard safety bounds in favor of soft-constraint penalties to achieve real-time performance. We present COAST (Corridor-Optimized Aerially-Safe Trajectories), a B-Spline based, online trajectory planner capable of formulating snap minimized trajectories with SFC guarantees. COAST divides the problem into two stages: an A* based front-end that generates geometrically simple SFCs (represented as a chain of rectangular prisms), and a quadratic programming back-end for control point optimization. To handle the non-convexity of SFC intersections, we leverage the finite support property of B-Splines, to ensure the spline never exits SFC boundaries. The control point optimization incorporates MINVO transforms for kinodynamic bounding, allowing COAST to design non-conservative, dynamically feasible trajectories, while a snap minimization matrix calculation provides flight smoothness. This formulation provides a formal geometric containment guarantee, while ensuring mean trajectory computation times under 5 ms for real-time deployment. We validate our results through high-fidelity simulation experiments. The source code can be found at: https://github.com/byu-magicc/Minimum-Snap-Trajectories
tldr: COAST is a two-stage B-Spline trajectory planner for quadrotors that efficiently computes snap-minimized trajectories with strict Safe Flight Corridor (SFC) guarantees in under 5 ms, validated in high-fidelity simulation.
tldr_zh: COAST 是一种用于四旋翼的两阶段 B 样条轨迹规划器，可在 5 毫秒内高效计算具有严格安全飞行走廊（SFC）保证的加加速度最小化轨迹，并在高保真仿真中进行了验证。

title: CueClash: Frontier Vision-Language Models Judge 3-D Relations Close to the Picture Plane
summary: A vision-language model (VLM) can judge 3-D relations from the picture or from the ground layout. In photographs the two usually agree. We separate them with CueClash, rendered scenes in which the 2-D cue for each of five relations is right on exactly half the statements. The shortcut gap is accuracy when the cue is right minus accuracy when it is wrong. For Claude Opus 5.5, GPT-5.5 and Gemini 3.6 Flash at low reasoning effort it is +18 to +37 percentage points. It is +7 to +29 without two relations whose cue-wrong items are confounded with borderline cases or occlusion. Given ground coordinates and each relation's definition, they answer 99 to 100% correctly. Pixel measurements with camera depths remove most of the gap for objects fitting through openings. The failure lies in the step from the picture to the layout. The maps that the models draw of the scene from above mostly keep the depth order but, like the picture, shorten depth. GPT-5.5's maps stay close to a copy of the picture. Opus 5.5's and Gemini's maps undo about 0.6 of this shortening. Gemini's then shrink all depths by a further uniform factor. Opus 5.5 follows the picture mainly on fits, and its maps correct depth about as much as human observers of real scenes do. The three models also lose accuracy on CV-Bench photographs where a reliable 2-D cue misleads. In two open models the layout information reaches the language model, but their maps lose much of it.
tldr: The paper introduces CueClash, a benchmark that separates 2-D pictorial cues from 3-D ground-truth relations in rendered scenes, and evaluates frontier VLMs' 3-D relation judgment, finding substantial shortcut gaps and identifying failures in the picture-to-layout step.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出CueClash基准，通过在渲染场景中分离二维图像线索与三维地面真实关系，评估前沿视觉语言模型（VLMs）的3D关系判断能力，发现模型存在显著的捷径差距，并定位到从图片到布局的转换失败。

title: SADL: On the Demand-Supply Geometry of Representation Collapse
summary: In Joint-Embedding Predictive Architectures (JEPAs), a well-constrained projector output does not by itself prevent representation collapse. We find that, from initialization, the encoder representation is dominated by a component shared by different inputs. A batch-normalized projector removes this component, so regularization after the projector cannot correct it, and the differences between representations shrink until they collapse. We propose SADL (Supply And Demand Loss), which keeps the original training objective and constrains the encoder directly when needed. SADL compares the representation differences that the projector output demands with the differences the encoder can retain and pass on to the projector, and adds a constraint on the encoder only when supply falls short of demand. It works with different Demand Regularizers and introduces no auxiliary networks, additional trainable parameters, or architectural changes. In single-task and jointly trained four-task LeWorldModel (LeWM) and INTACT experiments, SADL lowers the collapse rate over ten random seeds from 50% to 0%. After one epoch of training, encoder effective rank is 3.4-6.4 times that of the corresponding baseline without SADL, and latent prediction error falls to 1/20-1/303 of it. Without additional tuning, SADL stays robust as its loss weight spans orders of magnitude, and with several Demand Regularizers INTACT exceeds 95% mean search-free control success. On four image datasets, SADL also consistently improves accuracy and stability across random seeds. These results show that matching the representation differences a regularizer demands with the differences the encoder can supply leads to faster and more stable representation learning in control and image classification.
tldr: SADL addresses representation collapse in Joint-Embedding Predictive Architectures by directly constraining the encoder when its representation supply falls short of the predictor's demand, improving learning stability and performance in world models and image classification.
tldr_zh: SADL 通过直接约束编码器，在其表示供给不足时弥补预测器的需求，解决了联合嵌入预测架构中的表示坍缩问题，提升了世界模型和图像分类的学习稳定性与性能。

title: Magflow: Differentiable Simulation of Industrial-Grade 6D Magnetic Levitation
summary: Magnetic levitation with six-degrees-of-freedom enables frictionless transport and micrometer-scale positioning in principle, but low-level control is inherently challenging due to its complex and unstable dynamics. Industrial systems typically rely on deep hardware-software co-design, where mover and stator geometries are jointly designed to enable a compact, hand-crafted approximation of the electromagnetic force computation, thereby keeping control computationally tractable at kilohertz rates. However, this approach imposes overly conservative constraints on the operating workspace and the range of supported mover topologies. Instead of reducing the underlying physics to a hand-crafted approximation, we compute the physics directly. We introduce Magflow, a fully differentiable, GPU-parallel simulator for 6D magnetic levitation. It is used to train the first neural controller for an industrial-grade 6D magnetic levitation system that is learned purely from simulated physics. We show that the learned neural controller transfers zero-shot from simulation to real hardware while satisfying hard real-time constraints at 4 kHz. The learned controller achieves qualitatively new behaviors and even levitates a mover topology for which no hand-crafted solution exists. These results demonstrate that co-design is not a physical necessity for 6D magnetic levitation control. More broadly, control learning from simulated physics can find solutions beyond the reach of control engineering in demanding industrial domains. Source code and demonstration videos are publicly available at https://sites.google.com/view/magflow.
tldr: Magflow is a differentiable GPU-parallel simulator for 6D magnetic levitation, used to train the first neural controller that transfers zero-shot to real industrial hardware at 4 kHz, enabling new behaviors and levitation of a topology with no hand-crafted solution.
tldr_zh: Magflow 是一个用于六自由度磁悬浮的可微分 GPU 并行模拟器，用于训练首个零样本迁移到真实工业硬件（4 kHz）的神经控制器，实现了新行为并悬浮了没有手工解决方案的拓扑。

title: Levio: Smart Actuated Back-Exoskeleton via Retrofit of a Commercial Passive Device
summary: Passive back exoskeletons show promising benefits for reducing occupational musculoskeletal disorders. However, their assistance cannot be modulated towards the task requirements. Active exoskeletons offer opportunities for pose-specific assistance, but, developing these systems from scratch for research can be time consuming. Therefore, here, we present an accelerated design pipeline that retrofits a Commercial Off-The-Shelf (COTS) passive back exoskeleton, Laevo Flex, with COTS actuation (CubeMars AK10-9) and sensing (IMUs and load-cell) paradigms. Levio was able to provide assistance based on the user's pose. Nine participants performed stoop lifting with the original Laevo and the retrofit Levio system, in transparent and assisted modes. Compared to Laevo, Levio modulated the assistance provided between the bending and lifting phases of the stoop task. The passive assistance offered by Laevo was $25.2 \pm 4.3$ Nm and $30.6 \pm 9.5$ Nm respectively during the bending and lifting phases of the stoop tasks. Levio reduced the resistive torque during bending to $17.9 \pm 4.6$ Nm and offered increased assistance of $37.7 \pm 6.4$ Nm during lifting. Moreover, participants reported higher usability scores and lowest mean global discomfort score while using the Levio when compared to Laevo. These benefits demonstrates retrofitting passive exoskeletons is a viable direction for rapid prototyping of wearable exoskeletons for lifting.
tldr: This paper presents Levio, a smart actuated back-exoskeleton created by retrofitting a commercial passive exoskeleton with COTS actuators and sensors, enabling pose-specific assistance. Experiments show modulated assistance during stoop lifting and improved user comfort compared to the passive device.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了Levio，一种通过改造商用被动外骨骼并集成现成执行器和传感器而制成的智能主动背部外骨骼，能够根据姿势提供辅助。实验显示在弯腰举升过程中辅助可调节，且比被动设备更舒适。

title: The Multivariate Feedback Particle Filter for State-dependent Multiplicative Noises and Its Application to Attitude and Pose Estimations
summary: Nonlinear filtering with state-dependent multiplicative measurement noise poses a notable challenge for spacecraft attitude determination and robotic pose estimation. This work develops the FPF-DM, a decomposition scheme for feedback particle filters tailored to this family of filtering problems. Extending prior decomposition techniques for additive noise and polynomial measurement models, the proposed method resolves the key difficulty that state-dependent multiplicative noise breaks the polynomial assumption and prevents Hermite spectral backward recursion for the weighted Poisson's equation. By measure transformation and importance reweighting, we incorporate the inverse measurement covariance into particle weights and rescale the feedback gain to restore the polynomial-form Poisson's equation, with the decomposition generalized to non-uniformly weighted mixtures for closed-form gain computation. This general FPF-DM is instantiated on quaternion and dual-quaternion manifolds for attitude tracking and point-cloud registration. Simulations on 4D attitude tracking and 8D point-cloud registration verify that the instantiated filters using only 10 particles achieve superior accuracy and computational performance relative to baseline filters.
tldr: This paper introduces FPF-DM, a decomposition scheme for feedback particle filters handling state-dependent multiplicative noises, and applies it to attitude tracking on quaternion manifolds and pose/point-cloud registration using dual-quaternions, demonstrating accuracy and efficiency with few particles.
tldr_zh: 本文提出FPF-DM，一种针对状态相关乘性噪声的反馈粒子滤波分解方案，并将其应用于四元数姿态跟踪与对偶四元数点云配准，以少量粒子获得高精度和高效率。

title: BehaVerify: A Formal Verification Tool for Behavior Trees
summary: This paper presents BehaVerify, a verification toolbox for behavior trees (BTs) and Neuro-Symbolic BTs. BTs are a graphical language for planning and sequencing behaviors - similar to extended state machines - and are increasingly used in safety-critical domains. BehaVerify enables users to specify a BT using a Domain Specific Language (DSL) with formal syntax and semantics. This language further includes Linear Temporal Logic and Computation Tree Logic specifications. BehaVerify uses an efficient encoding into nuXmv, called fastforwarding, to quickly verify if a specification holds over the BT. Additionally, BehaVerify can generate implementations of the BT in Python and Haskell. Through Python, BehaVerify has been integrated with PyTrees and Robot Operating System (ROS) and has been deployed to several autonomous robotic systems, including for verifying runtime monitors. While prior works have developed the underlying theory, this manuscript focuses on the toolbox usage, functionality and implementation. BehaVerify is open source: https://github.com/verivital/behaverify
tldr: BehaVerify is an open-source formal verification tool for behavior trees and neuro-symbolic behavior trees, enabling specification via a DSL with LTL/CTL logic and efficient verification using nuXmv, with integrations for Python, Haskell, PyTrees, and ROS for autonomous robotic systems.
tldr_zh: BehaVerify 是一个用于行为树和神经符号行为树的开源形式验证工具，通过提供带 LTL/CTL 逻辑的领域特定语言和基于 nuXmv 的高效验证，并集成 Python、Haskell、PyTrees 和 ROS，适用于自主机器人系统。

title: Plenty to FRET About: From Hazard Analysis to Formal Requirements for Robot-Assisted Dressing
summary: Understanding requirements for systems involving humans and robots is essential for providing robust evidence that such systems behave correctly. Requirements formalisation approaches such as the Formal Requirements Elicitation Tool (FRET) can support the transition from unstructured natural language to formal representations suitable for verification. In this paper, we formalise 146 hazard-derived natural-language requirements for a Robot-Assisted Dressing (RAD) case study, previously classified using a taxonomy of Human-Robot Teamwork (HRT) requirements. Through an iterative process involving domain-expert clarification, these were represented by 117 unique FRETISH requirements. Formalisation exposed ambiguities, temporal and probabilistic assumptions, and cases where source requirements needed to be decomposed or could be consolidated because they expressed the same formal behaviour. Temporal analysis showed that 70.1% of the unique FRETISH requirements use either immediate-response or ordering constraints (immediately or before), while formalisation also exposed relationships between requirements across HRT taxonomy categories. We further analyse the formal semantics and realisability of the resulting requirements. The results show that HRT classification and formalisation provide complementary views: the taxonomy captures the teamwork concern represented by a requirement, while FRETISH makes the required behaviour explicit. We report practical lessons and limitations of applying FRET to HRT requirements and identify directions for further work.
tldr: The paper formalizes 146 hazard-derived natural-language requirements for Robot-Assisted Dressing (RAD) using the Formal Requirements Elicitation Tool (FRET), producing 117 unique FRETISH requirements. It analyzes their formal semantics, realisability, and temporal properties, revealing ambiguities and relationships across the Human-Robot Teamwork (HRT) taxonomy, and provides practical lessons for applying FRET to HRT requirements.
tldr_zh: 本文使用形式化需求获取工具 (FRET) 将机器人辅助穿衣 (RAD) 的146条源自危害的自然语言需求形式化为117条唯一的FRETISH需求。文章分析了这些需求的形式化语义、可实现性和时间特性，揭示了歧义及跨人机团队协作 (HRT) 分类法需求之间的关系，并总结了将FRET应用于HRT需求的实践经验与局限性。

title: SkiNet-Sim: Simulating Petri Nets with Data for the Verification and Validation of Controllers for Autonomous Systems
summary:
A large amount of high-level Petri net formalisms has been investigated and deployed in academic settings over the past decades, but these deployments fail to reach practical applications, despite the strong guarantees they can bring to stakeholders. In particular, the lack of direct benefits from end-users reduces the appeal of Petri nets, both due to the overly simple classical Petri net formalism, and the overly specialized high-level formalisms, on top of state-space explosion issues.
  In this work, we investigate how a middle-ground could be reached, by separating the implementation-specific aspects of software or hardware behaviors, from the classical Petri net semantics. The goal is to benefit from the sought-after aspects of Petri nets, namely their simple firing semantic and model-checking capabilities, while still being able to augment their behavior to best reflect the modelled system. We present a formal model of Interpreted Petri nets with data-aware transitions and tokens. We illustrate this formalism by modelling the executive layer of a robotic system, and provide a lightweight tool to augment classical Petri nets for general purpose applications, as well as data-aware state-space exploration for model-checking. Their specialization in the context of autonomous robotics is showcased, with a complete industrial inspection mission use-case, to compare simulation and model-checking results between the classical and the new data-aware Petri net semantic.
tldr: The paper proposes a data-aware Petri net formalism and tool for simulating and model-checking robotics controllers, demonstrated on an industrial inspection mission with a robotic system.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了一种数据感知Petri网形式化方法及工具，用于机器人控制器的仿真与模型检测，并在工业巡检任务中进行了演示。

title: Benchmarking Deep Learning Models for Wheelchair Configuration Classification in Accessible Automated Vehicle Applications
summary: Making automated vehicles accessible requires consideration of vulnerable road users, including wheelchair users. To offer a more tailored experience that supports independence for this group, vehicle design needs to accommodate the wide range of wheelchair configurations. However, wheelchairs are individualized, varying in frame geometry, propulsion, and visual appearance. Moreover, occupants or accessories may obscure visual cues. Existing mobility-aid datasets only label the presence of a wheelchair, rather than describing its specific configuration. To fill this gap, this paper introduces the Wheelchair Configuration Image Dataset (WCID), comprising 467 face-blurred images across 192 capture groups solely for evaluation. Each image is annotated with (i) a two-class label of manual or powered, (ii) a chair subtype, (iii) occupancy, viewpoint, setting, lighting, occlusion, propulsion, and control, with a 273-image validation split and 194-image test split. Three convolutional neural network backbones and a frozen vision-language probe are trained on an external image dataset and evaluated on WCID to measure cross-dataset generalization, while also testing robustness using Gaussian blur. Convolutional models do well on clean images, but performance drops under strong blur, leaving a gap before deployment. Code, split assignments, labels, trained weights, and the face-blurred images is available at: https://github.com/Mi3-Lab/MAID
tldr: This paper introduces a new dataset and benchmarks deep learning models for classifying wheelchair configurations from images, targeting accessibility in automated vehicles. It finds that convolutional models perform well on clean images but degrade under blur, indicating a gap for deployment.
tldr_zh: 本文提出一个新数据集，并基准测试了深度学习模型对轮椅配置的分类能力，面向自动化车辆的无障碍应用。研究发现卷积模型在清晰图像上表现良好，但在强模糊下性能下降，表明部署前仍有差距。

title: Practice in Text, Act in Pixels: Correcting Where Perception Fails
summary: GUI agents can learn cheaply from a text view of an interface and act on screenshots through a vision-language screen reader. Yet on a simulated mobile platform with a low-cost reader, policies that complete most tasks in text fail on many of the same tasks on screenshots. We ask where a small budget of real screenshots is best spent to close this gap. We find that the reader's misreads are systematic and recur on the same interface elements. Noise matched to the reader's error rates, a natural sim-to-real remedy, misses this structure, and in a pre-specified comparison it did not beat training the policy directly on screenshots. We therefore correct the misreads at their source with reader alignment, which fine-tunes the reader on screenshots paired with their text views. The reader learns to output each screen's text view, as in text practice, and the policy stays unchanged. Spent on the reader, the screenshot budget gives 80.9% full-task success on new task instances, against 55.6% when spent on training the policy. Given the same labeled screenshots, adapting the reader also beats adapting the policy, and a single aligned reader improves every text-trained policy we tried without retraining any of them.
tldr: This paper studies GUI agents that train on text views but act on screenshots via a vision-language screen reader, finding that reader misreads are systematic. It proposes reader alignment—fine-tuning the reader on paired screenshots and text views—which outperforms spending a limited screenshot budget on policy training, improving success from 55.6% to 80.9%.
tldr_zh: 本文研究GUI智能体在文本视图上训练但通过视觉语言屏幕阅读器在截图上执行的问题，发现阅读器的误读是系统性的。提出阅读器对齐方法，在配对截图和文本视图上微调阅读器，优于将有限的截图预算用于策略训练，成功率从55.6%提升到80.9%。

title: Can a World Model Predict a Deepfake Video? A Consistency Margin Prior for Deepfake Detection
summary: Deepfake detectors often perform well on the dataset they are trained on, but their performance drops when tested on videos from different datasets. In this paper, we study whether a predictive video model can provide a signal that generalizes better across datasets. Instead of relying only on generator-specific artifacts, as many existing detectors do, we use a model trained to predict natural video and measure the difference between what it predicts and what it observes in a video. Using V-JEPA 2.1, we keep the encoder frozen and adapt the predictor using rank-16 LoRA. We define the difference between the predictor output and the frozen encoder target as the prediction residual. We hypothesize that manipulated clips produce, on average, larger prediction residuals than authentic clips, and use this as our consistency-margin prior. We process these residuals using a lightweight Latent Consistency Head (LCH), which separates residual magnitude from direction for training and classification. To test whether the direction of the consistency margin affects cross-dataset generalization, we compare standard and reversed margin objectives while keeping the remaining training setup fixed. We match the two settings on FF++ validation performance before evaluating them on unseen data. The reversed-margin setting exhibits a larger cross dataset generalization gap on average, providing evidence that the direction of the consistency margin affects cross-dataset transfer. Our complete model adds only 8.25M trainable parameters, which is 2.47% of the total 334M parameters. Trained only on FF++, it achieves an AUC of 90.5 on Celeb-DFv2 and performs well across several other cross-dataset benchmarks. Our ablations show that separating residual magnitude from direction, reducing dataset-specific variation, and using a low-rank projection improve cross-dataset generalization in our experiments.
tldr: This paper proposes a deepfake detection method using a predictive video world model (V-JEPA 2.1) to compute prediction residuals, introducing a consistency-margin prior and a lightweight head to improve cross-dataset generalization.
tldr_zh: 本文提出一种深度伪造检测方法，利用预测性视频世界模型（V-JEPA 2.1）计算预测残差，引入一致性边界先验和轻量级头以提升跨数据集的泛化能力。

title: ROSMonitoring in Action: Runtime Monitoring and Enforcement for ROS 2 Actions
summary: Robotic applications often rely on long-running operations, such as navigation, manipulation, and inspection, which in ROS~2 are commonly implemented as actions. Unlike topics and services, actions involve a structured lifecycle comprising goal submission and acceptance, feedback, status updates, result retrieval, and cancellation. Existing versions of ROSMonitoring support topics and services, but do not reconstruct this lifecycle or expose action-level events to a runtime-verification oracle.
